corrections.why: The register gives the county as Idaho County, Idaho. Idaho is the state.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1918 tent camp and the 1922 log cabin came before the cupola. Three sources date the 6 by 6 foot cupola to 1934 (Idaho Fire Lookouts, firelookout.com, Kemnow) and two date it to 1935 (the register and Keeping Watch). The record's 1935 follows the register.
The register describes the two log structures and was registered in 1995, before the 2013 fire. The other sources agree that the fire destroyed the structures, so the status stays gone.

notes_for_editor: Only the 1934 versus 1935 cupola date is disputed; the 1951 abandonment and the 2013 fire agree across sources. Elevation differs: the register gives 2,247 m (7,372 ft), and firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 7,424 ft. The record's elevation was left as it is. No source read describes the summit today. The 1951 Havre item is quoted on Kemnow's site and was not checked against the original newspaper.
